questions.question: In the Generic Test Automation Architecture (gTAA), which artifacts belong to the Definition Layer? (Select all that apply)

options.explanation: The execution engine is part of the Execution Layer, not the Definition Layer
Keyword libraries belong to the Adaptation Layer, not the Definition Layer

questions.question: In the Generic Test Automation Architecture (gTAA), which components belong to the Execution Layer? (Select all that apply)

options.explanation: Test data files belong to the Definition Layer, not the Execution Layer
SeleniumLibrary is part of the Adaptation Layer, not the Execution Layer

questions.question: In the Generic Test Automation Architecture (gTAA), which libraries belong to the Adaptation Layer? (Select all that apply)

options.explanation: The parser is part of the Execution Layer (Robot Framework core), not the Adaptation Layer
Reports and logs are outputs from the Execution Layer, not components of the Adaptation Layer

questions.question: Which of the following components are included in Robot Framework itself?

options.text: A parser to read test data and build an execution model
Web front-end automation libraries like SeleniumLibrary
options.explanation: Web automation libraries are external libraries, not part of Robot Framework itself

options.text: An execution engine to process models and execute keywords

options.explanation: Database libraries are external libraries, not included in Robot Framework itself

options.text: Generic standard libraries for data processing and file operations

options.explanation: Editors and IDEs are external tools, not part of Robot Framework

questions.question: What is the primary prerequisite for running Robot Framework?

options.explanation: Robot Framework is built on Python, not Java

options.text: An officially supported version of the Python interpreter

options.explanation: Robot Framework is built on Python, not JavaScript/Node.js
Robot Framework is built on Python, not .NET

questions.question: In the gTAA model, which layer is responsible for connecting Robot Framework to the System Under Test (SUT)?

options.explanation: The Definition Layer contains test data and keywords, not the connection to SUT
The Execution Layer processes the execution model but doesn't directly connect to the SUT
There is no Integration Layer in the gTAA model

questions.question: How are Robot Framework and its libraries typically installed?

options.explanation: Maven is for Java packages; Robot Framework uses Python's package ecosystem

options.text: Via pip (package installer for Python) from PyPI.org

options.explanation: npm is for JavaScript packages; Robot Framework uses Python's pip

options.text: By downloading and compiling source code
options.explanation: While possible, the typical and recommended way is using pip from PyPI
